YUSEA works alongside provinces, cities and communities to shape urban growth that is equitable, low-carbon and locally led.

This is mock content. It stands in for the About page body from WordPress.

Who we are

A team of planners, researchers and organisers based in Viet Nam, working with partners across Southeast Asia.

How we work

  • We start from the places plans describe, not from the plans.
  • We bring young people into decisions they will live with longest.
  • We publish our data and methods openly.
